_brief: Tal 2026-10-03 (batch item 2, Frame.io FLOWERS FOR STRANGERS / CLEANER JERUSLAEM): "The strongest hook should be me giving him the flowers and immediately seeing him smile/react. I don't think we need much dialogue here. Make it mostly: Giving flowers -> reaction -> smile -> close-ups -> a few fast emotional cuts. Keep it short and visual." Erez grammar (wide -> 4-frame snap -> tight hold -> hard cut), slow-mo on the smile and the laugh, grade:false. POV = local 968x1280 Meta file; captions come from the c957346b hand translation via an audio graft at the same second (local = c957 + 0.04s, corr 0.99) - every captioned span re-read 2026-10-03 with Groq large-v3 + turbo (he): bishvilcha 8.06, bishvilcha ach sheli ha-yakar 9.5-11.0, anachnu rotzim lesameach otcha 13.0-14.6, toda (8349) 8.28. Observer 8342 sits at POV - 5.54s (envelope xcorr 0.35, twice; the handshake lines up at 8342 28.0 = POV 33.5). The first rose is handed over HIDDEN behind his back in 8342, so the handover is the POV shot and 8342 is used for Tal beside him, grinning, right after it.
beats: HOOK, wide: Tal's white rose held out in the foreground, the cleaner looks up from his cart and reaches - a face and the gift in frame 0. Starts after 'chag sameach' (run ends 7.63), so no greeting.
4-frame snap onto his hands and face as he takes it
TIGHT: the rose goes into his hand - 'FOR YOU' (bishvilcha 7.85-8.82, two models). Tight starts at 8.1 so this beat holds 74% of that line and it is not dropped as a straddle.

REACTION 1, puzzled: he looks at Tal - 'FOR YOU, MY DEAR BROTHER' (9.22-11.07). Ends 10.7333, the last frame before the whip pan, and past 81.8% of the line so all five words stay on screen. [r3: out 10.7667 - with the 0.04s graft correction the window must reach c957 10.70+ or the straddle rule drops BROTHER (r2 rendered MY DEAR)]
CUT to the observer iPhone, wide: Tal steps out beside him, the girls behind are laughing. Covers the POV whip pan; POV sound continues underneath (graft at POV 10.74). [r3: in 5.2333 = POV 10.7733]
TIGHT: Tal grinning next to him - Tal is a character, not just the camera (LESSONS 73)
back to POV, wide: the smile arrives as a girl hands him a red rose [r2: own audio, no graft - continuous with the slow beat]
4-frame snap onto his face [r2: x 0.52 -> 0.62, the face was cut by the right edge]
SLOW-MO x0.5: THE SMILE - the face changing is the whole video. Sound real-time 12.37-13.17 (the girl's 'ze bishvilcha' plays uncaptioned under it), ends before 'anachnu' at 13.32.
soft smile at the roses, then at us - 'WE WANT TO MAKE YOU HAPPY' (13.32-14.63, both models identical). Starts at 13.1667 = the slow beat's sound out-point, 0.15s before the line.
wide: more roses, he is laughing. nocap: the only word here is 'toda' (both models) and its timing is not pinned
SLOW-MO x0.5: THE BIGGEST LAUGH, roses in hand - best reaction in the take
fast emotional cut: still grinning, he holds the roses out
LATER, the lit street (observer iPhone, proxy only): he pushes his cart toward the camera, smiling
TIGHT: the grin, head tilted - ends before the jump in the source at 7.5
ENDING: he lifts the red roses to us - 'THANK YOU' (toda 8.28-8.68, both models) - his grin with the flowers is the last image [r2: out 8.9333, on the frame grid - the file ends at 9.00]
_sound: bedOnly: the soundtrack is LOCATION-SOUND.wav in this folder - the SAME source windows the beats play (graft window, or real-time window under a slow-mo beat), extracted as continuous runs, denoised once per run (-a 10, 0.5s pre-roll), no per-beat gain. Built by the ek story-editor soundtrack.py (beat-by-beat denoise + level-matching put 20 dB steps and DeepFilterNet onset dips at 4-frame snap joins where the sound is really continuous: measured -64 dB holes at 4.57s/4.70s in r3). Rebuild it if any beat window changes. No music: Tal asked for emotional music on the old-lady cut; none exists in the repo and none is ripped.
